name: io.github.rudraptpsingh/figbridge
description: Free, local MCP bridge for Figma — HTML, CSS, Tailwind, tokens, agent handoff bundles.

environmentVariables.name: FIGBRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Preferred TCP port for the local HTTP+SSE bridge that the Figma plugin connects to. Defaults to 7331. If the port is in use, the bridge walks 7331..7340 automatically.
